_comment: Compiler configuration for CSU_PM's core (Cadence Xtensa LX7.1.10, CORE_NAME pm_core_v1, HW_CONFIGID 0xc000b286/0x2a8a7d6a, from the .xtensa.info note of CIX's csupm_sky1 ELF). scripts/open/xtensa_core.py takes Espressif's ESP32-S3 overlay (LX7, the closest public configuration) and applies these overrides. Evidence: instruction counts from 'xtensa_isa.py census' over CIX's ELF (2026-10-31): every option set to 1 is used by CIX's compiler, every option set to 0 never is. Options the compiler does not use (caches, MMU, interrupts, AREGS) do not matter here.

XCHAL_HAVE_MAC16.why: no MAC16 opcode (op0 4) anywhere in CIX's code

XCHAL_HAVE_S32C1I.why: never used; FreeRTOS here runs on one core with interrupts masked

XCHAL_HAVE_THREADPTR.why: RUR/WUR only touch the FP control and status registers

used: single-precision FPU with divide (DIV0.S/DIVN.S/MADDN.S) and post-increment loads
XTENSA_MARCH stays at the overlay's LX7.0.12: GCC only gains LX7.0 instructions, which LX7.1 has
